item.title: Trump, Starmer agree Strait of Hormuz must reopen as Middle East conflict escalates
item.summary: Strait of Hormuz closure dominates a Trump-Starmer call, as Trump's 48-hour ultimatum to Iran warns of further U.S. strikes on Iranian energy infrastructure.

item.title: Iran threatens mass ‘water war’ with strikes on key plants in days, UN official warns
item.summary: Iran threatens to target desalination and energy infrastructure within days, a U.N. official warns, citing lasting consequences for global markets and water supplies.

item.title: Scott Bessent calls out 'terrible framing' during clash with NBC News host on Iranian oil
item.summary: Scott Bessent accused NBC's Kristen Welker of "terrible framing" during an exchange about Iranian oil on Sunday, as the host pressed the treasury secretary on why the U.S. lifted sanctions.

item.title: Illegal immigrant charged with killing Loyola student released under Biden, DHS says
item.summary: DHS confirmed Venezuelan national Jose Medina-Medina, charged wit killing Loyola student Sheridan Gorman, entered the U.S. under the Biden administration and was caught and released.

item.title: Air Canada jet hits vehicle, forcing New York's LaGuardia airport to close
item.summary: An Air Canada Express regional jet crashed into a vehicle on the ground after landing at New York's LaGuardia Airport, forcing the airport to close.

item.title: Iowa hits clutch 3-pointer in closing seconds to stun Florida
item.summary: The Iowa Hawkeyes topped defending national champion Florida Gators in the NCAA Men's Basketball Tournament on Sunday night, 73-72. Alvaro Folgueiras netted the go-ahead basket.

item.title: Authorities share update on circumstances around missing college student Jimmy Gracey's death
item.summary: University of Alabama student Jimmy Gracey, 20, went missing in Barcelona during Spring Break. His body was found near a nightclub.

item.title: Jeffries tells Trump to keep his 'reckless mouth shut' after president calls Democratic Party 'greatest enemy'
item.summary: Hakeem Jeffries said Sunday that President Trump should keep his "reckless mouth shut" after the president called Democrats America's "greatest enemy" on Truth Social.

item.title: Texas Democratic Senate nominee James Talarico doubles down on God being "beyond gender" comments
item.summary: James Talarico defended his remarks on God and gender during a Thursday podcast appearance while criticizing GOP rivals, calling to end the filibuster, and outlining a Senate campaign focused on coalition-building ahead of the 2026 election.

item.title: 9 suspects arrested after $7M in stolen cargo seized in Southern California bust
item.summary: Nine suspects were arrested after authorities recovered $7 million in stolen cargo and $1 million in cash as part of a cargo theft bust in California.
